name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 1 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 1a. Is deeply concerned by the special European Council’s decision to endorse the ReArm Europe Plan put forward by the Commission; believes that increasing defence spending is not conducive to lasting peace, and that common indebtedness and suspensions of the stability pact should instead be used to support measures aimed at helping EU citizens cope with rising living costs and to fund basic services;
